baseline.formula: ef / sqrt((ef + nf) * (ef + ep)); zero denominator maps to 0.0
baseline.name: line_ochiai

codedoctor_fl_v1.branch_outcome: one GCC/gcov branch arc identified by source line and line-local branch index; taken iff count > 0
codedoctor_fl_v1.branch_spectrum: ef/ep count failing/passing repair tests taking the outcome; nf/np count failing/passing repair tests not taking it
codedoctor_fl_v1.branch_to_line: maximum branch Ochiai on the source line; 0.0 when the line has no branch outcome
codedoctor_fl_v1.formula: the same Ochiai formula is applied independently to line and branch spectra
codedoctor_fl_v1.name: line_ochiai_with_branch_tiebreak
codedoctor_fl_v1.restriction: branch evidence only breaks exact line-score ties and cannot reverse distinct line-score groups

protocol.compile_flags: gcc -g -O0 --coverage with the frozen signal-dump header
protocol.coverage_isolation: fresh executable, gcno workspace, and Docker container per repair test

tie_evaluation.deterministic_rank: position after the frozen ranking key
